name: Las Terrazas Resort
insider_take: This intimate beachfront resort sits on one of Belize's most pristine stretches of coastline, where the Caribbean Sea meets world-class diving just steps from your suite.
whats_special: Las Terrazas is perfectly positioned on Ambergris Caye, just minutes from the Belize Barrier Reef - the second-largest coral reef system in the world. The resort's location in San Pedro puts you at the heart of Belize's diving and snorkeling paradise, where you can spot nurse sharks, stingrays, and vibrant coral formations. The property features traditional Belizean architecture with modern luxury touches, and many suites offer direct beach access.
pro_tip: Book a sunset sailing trip to Hol Chan Marine Reserve - it's only a 10-minute boat ride away and offers some of the Caribbean's best snorkeling, plus you'll likely encounter manatees and sea turtles.
dont_miss: Take a day trip to the famous Blue Hole, just 40 miles offshore - this UNESCO World Heritage site is a bucket-list diving experience. Back on land, explore San Pedro's vibrant local culture, sample fresh conch fritters at beachside grills, and catch the weekly lobster festival if you're visiting during lobster season (June-February).
pros: Beautiful oceanfront location with stunning Caribbean views
Spacious suites with private terraces and modern amenities
Excellent diving and snorkeling access to Belize Barrier Reef
Intimate boutique resort atmosphere with personalized service
cons: Remote island location requires boat transfers
Limited dining options due to boutique size
